sentence: Oh my god, they just announced the tour dates! I've been waiting six years for this moment and I literally cannot stop shaking! The stadium show is coming to my city in August and I am buying tickets the second they drop! This is the best news I've heard all year! All year!

Tickets just went on sale and I got front row! Front row! I refreshed that page for forty-five minutes straight and my hands are still trembling. I'm going to be close enough to make eye contact! This is happening, this is actually happening, and I haven't felt this alive in years!

Did you see the surprise guest list?! They're bringing out three of my favorite artists for the encore! Three! I have been screaming into a pillow for the last twenty minutes because I cannot contain this energy! My friends are getting hourly texts and they are sick of me already but I do not care!

The reunion tour is REAL! After fifteen years they are getting back on stage together and my teenage self is sobbing inside my adult body! I am going to wear the exact same t-shirt I wore to their last show and I am going to scream every single lyric until my voice gives out!

VIP packages just dropped and I sold my couch to afford one! Worth it, completely worth it, I will sit on the floor for a year if it means I get the meet-and-greet and the soundcheck access! Do you understand what this means?! I get to be in the same room as them! Breathing the same air!

She announced a secret intimate show at a 300-person venue and I got in! Three hundred people! I'm going to be able to see every facial expression, every guitar pick, every moment! My hands are sweating, my heart is racing, and I have approximately ninety days to figure out what to wear!

The setlist for opening night just leaked and they are playing the deep cuts! The deep cuts that nobody has performed live in twenty years! I am literally crying happy tears into my keyboard right now because this is the show I have dreamed about since I was fourteen years old!

Festival lineup just dropped and it is absolutely STACKED! Every headliner is someone I would pay full price to see alone and they are all on the same stage in the same weekend! I am buying the four-day pass without even thinking about it because this is a once-in-a-decade kind of lineup!

My favorite band added a second night because the first sold out in eight minutes and I got tickets to BOTH! Two nights in a row, two completely different setlists, and I am going to lose my mind in the best possible way! I have been bouncing around my apartment for an hour and I cannot calm down!

They just confirmed the orchestra is joining them for the symphony tour! With the full philharmonic, every song reimagined, in the most beautiful concert hall in the country! I am going to need to invest in waterproof mascara because I am absolutely going to weep through the entire performance!

She's home! She's actually home! Tiny brown nose, floppy ears that won't stay up, and the most ridiculous puppy belly I have ever seen in my life! She fell asleep in my lap within ten minutes and I haven't moved since because what if I disturb the most perfect creature ever to exist on this planet?!

We just signed the adoption papers and the foster handed me a wiggling little potato with paws and I think my heart actually grew three sizes! Her name is Biscuit and she licked my face and now I am a person who has a dog and I cannot believe how good this feels!

The shelter called and said our application was approved! Approved! After three months of waiting, I get to bring home the goofy golden mix who picked me by sitting on my shoes! On Saturday she will be MY DOG and I have already bought four kinds of toys and a tiny rain jacket!

Look at his little face! Look at it! He has one floppy ear and one pointy ear and white toe socks and a tail that has not stopped wagging since we left the shelter! I am sitting on the kitchen floor refusing to leave because he is napping on my foot and this is genuinely the happiest I have ever been!

First day with the puppy and she has already discovered the squeaky toy, fallen off the couch (gently!), and given me thirty seven kisses! THIRTY SEVEN! I counted! My cheeks hurt from smiling and I have taken approximately four hundred photos and every single one is going to my mother immediately!

He learned to sit! On his second day! He looked up at me with those enormous puppy eyes and put his little butt down and I screamed and gave him three treats in a row and now he keeps sitting hoping for more! I am raising a genius! An actual, certified, four-pound genius!

The rescue just sent the home visit confirmation and we PASSED! In two days I am driving four hours to pick up the scruffy little terrier mix I have been obsessing over for weeks! I have built a puppy corner, bought a crate, named her three times, and I am vibrating with anticipation!

She did the play bow! The PLAY BOW! Little front legs down, tail in the air, big brown eyes saying come chase me! I have not played tug-of-war in twenty years and I just spent ninety minutes on the living room rug being absolutely demolished by a six-pound creature and I have never been happier!

Adoption day is here and I'm shaking in the parking lot of the shelter! In ten minutes a small fuzzy creature is going to officially become a member of my family and I have already cried twice in the car! This is what I imagine winning the lottery feels like except better because puppies!

He's curled up in my arms snoring and I am going to keep him forever! Forever! Look at the tiny pink pads on his feet! Look at the soft fuzz on his belly! Look at the way his ear twitches when he dreams! Every single thing about this dog is a miracle and I will be defending that opinion to my grave!

HE PROPOSED! Last night, under the lights of the pier, ring in his pocket the whole dinner and I had NO IDEA! I am engaged! I am someone's fiancée! I have been staring at my hand for fourteen hours and I have called every single person in my contacts and I am calling YOU next!

She said yes! She said yes! I planned it for six months, had the ring made by hand, hid it inside a hollowed-out book on the bookshelf where she found it during our anniversary, and she actually said YES! I am marrying my best friend! This is the best day of my entire life!

We're getting married! Officially, on paper, with all the trimmings! He got down on one knee in the cabin we rented for our weekend away and I screamed so loudly the people in the next cabin came over to check on us and ended up popping a bottle of champagne with us in the snow!

I'm engaged! ENGAGED! After eight years of being asked when we were going to make it official, we finally made it official, and she put the most beautiful vintage ring on my finger under a sky full of stars! I cannot stop crying and I cannot stop laughing and I cannot stop telling everyone!

He flew my entire family in without me knowing! When I walked into the surprise dinner everyone I love was in the room and then he got down on one knee and I lost it, completely lost it, and now I'm wearing a ring and a permanent grin and my face genuinely hurts from how much I'm smiling!

She got down on one knee in front of the lighthouse where we had our first date! She remembered every detail, the wind off the water, the gulls, the way the sun hit the rocks, and she made a whole speech and I could barely breathe and now we are getting married and I just want to scream from the rooftops!

The ring fits perfectly and I am marrying the love of my life next summer! He pulled it off with no warning, completely surprised me on a regular Tuesday morning over breakfast, and I haven't been able to wipe the smile off my face for three days! My cheeks ache! I love everything! I love EVERYTHING!

We're getting married next October and I cannot wait! I have already started a venue spreadsheet, picked out my dress in my head twelve times, and pinned approximately eight hundred floral arrangements! My fiancé thinks I'm a little intense and he is correct and I will NOT be apologizing because we're getting MARRIED!

I just proposed! At sunset on the rooftop of the apartment where we had our first kiss four years ago! She gasped and started crying and said yes through tears and we slow danced with no music while the city lit up around us and it was every single thing I had hoped it would be and more!

There is a diamond on my finger and I keep looking at it and squealing! I am someone's fiancé now! We have plans, real plans, with a venue and a date and a guest list, and in two hundred and ninety days I am going to walk down an aisle toward the most wonderful person on the planet!

I GOT THE PROMOTION! I just walked out of the meeting and I'm trying not to scream in the hallway but my hands won't stop shaking and my face hurts from smiling! Senior director! After three years of grinding, three years of late nights, three years of doubting myself! It's finally happening!

My boss just pulled me into her office, sat me down, and offered me the VP role! VP! I'm thirty-one years old and they want me to run an entire division! I had to bite the inside of my cheek to stop from crying in front of her and now I'm in the bathroom doing a silent dance of pure joy!

The promotion came through and the raise is THIRTY PERCENT! Thirty! I can finally pay off the loans, move out of my studio, take my mom on the vacation she's been dreaming about for ten years! Everything I have been working toward is happening simultaneously and I feel like I'm floating!

I have a corner office! A corner office with windows on two sides and a view of the river! My name is on the door and there is a fresh stack of business cards on the desk with my new title and I am sitting in this chair and I cannot stop spinning around like a kid because I made it I made it I made it!

My team just announced it at the all-hands and everyone applauded and someone yelled my name and I waved like a complete dork from my desk and I do not even care! I am a partner at the firm! Partner! Five years ahead of schedule! I'm calling my dad the minute I get home and he is going to LOSE IT!

Lead engineer! They picked me to be the lead engineer on the new platform team! I get to architect a system from scratch with a budget and headcount and everything I have dreamed about since I started writing code at thirteen! I am going to do the best work of my life and I am so ready!

She offered me the head of design role this morning and I accepted before she finished the sentence! Head of design at thirty-four! I will be running the whole creative org and I have so many ideas and so much energy and I cannot wait to start on Monday and absolutely run with this!

I just got the call! I am the new regional manager! Twelve stores, two hundred employees, my own budget, and the trust of the company I have given everything to for the last six years! I am sitting in my car in the driveway and I have already called four people and I'm only halfway through the list!

The board approved my promotion to chief of staff! I'm thirty years old and I'm going to be in every strategic meeting, sitting next to the CEO, building the future of the company! I had to pretend to be calm in the announcement and now I am alone in my car SCREAMING because this is unreal!

I am the new principal! I have been dreaming about this since I was a brand-new teacher fifteen years ago and today the superintendent walked into my classroom and offered me the position! I am going to be a PRINCIPAL! With my own school! And ideas! And the chance to make every single child's day better!

I just walked out of the theater and I am still vibrating! That was the best movie I have seen in TEN YEARS! Every scene was a masterpiece, every performance was Oscar-worthy, and the ending! THE ENDING! I cannot wait to see it again next weekend with everyone I have ever met!

Opening night, midnight showing, I was in my seat ninety minutes early and it was WORTH IT! The crowd cheered at every reveal, gasped at every twist, and I have not felt that kind of collective electricity in a theater since I was a kid! Cinema is BACK and I am here for every minute!

The new sci-fi epic is INCREDIBLE! Three hours flew by in what felt like forty minutes and I left the theater shaking! The cinematography was insane, the score was transcendent, and I am going to be thinking about that final shot for the rest of my actual life! Go see it! Go see it NOW!

Just got out of the early screening and I CANNOT believe what I just saw! The director outdid himself, the cast was on absolute fire, and there is a sequence in the third act that had me literally clutching the armrest! I'm telling everyone, calling everyone, this is THE movie of the year!

She was robbed of every award she should have won and she came back swinging with a performance that will be studied in film schools for the next fifty years! The whole theater stood up and applauded at the credits! Stood up! Applauded! I had goosebumps from the opening shot to the final fade!

The new animated film is a MIRACLE! Every frame is hand-painted in this dreamlike watercolor style, the music made me weep openly in a public theater, and the story is the most life-affirming thing I have seen since I was a kid! Bring tissues! Bring everyone you love! Bring your whole HEART!

I just watched the prequel and it is BETTER than the original! I did not think that was possible! It expanded the world in ways I never imagined, gave us answers I didn't know I needed, and somehow set up the next film while still being a complete and satisfying story on its own! TEN OUT OF TEN!

The horror movie everyone was hyping LIVED up to it and exceeded every expectation! I jumped out of my seat three times, screamed once out loud, and now I'm too afraid to walk to my car alone but I LOVED every terrifying second of it! Sleep is overrated and this movie was a religious experience!

The musical adaptation works and I am EUPHORIC! Every song was a banger, the choreography was breathtaking, and the lead has a voice from another galaxy! I sang along to every chorus in my head and the woman next to me sang along OUT LOUD and honestly that just made the experience even better!

The indie film that has been getting all the festival buzz is finally in theaters and I caught the first show! It is EVERY bit as good as they said! The lead performance broke me in half, the script is razor-sharp, and the final monologue is going to haunt me in the best possible way for weeks!

I JUST BOOKED IT! Two weeks in Japan in April, cherry blossom season, a tiny ryokan in Kyoto, bullet trains, the whole thing! I have been saving for this trip for FOUR YEARS and tonight I clicked the button and now it is actually real and I am going to JAPAN!

The flights are confirmed, the hotel is booked, and in eighty-three days I am going to be sitting on a beach in Greece eating fresh seafood and watching the sun go down over the Aegean! I keep refreshing the confirmation email like it might disappear and I cannot stop grinning at my screen!

Patagonia! We are going to Patagonia! Three weeks of glaciers, mountain trekking, those impossible blue lakes I have been staring at on the internet for a decade, and I just hit confirm on the booking and now it's real and I am SHAKING with excitement! This is the trip of a lifetime and it's HAPPENING!

I cashed in every credit card point I have and booked us business class to Bali! BUSINESS CLASS! Lie-flat seats, champagne, the works! We are going to honeymoon like absolute royalty and I cannot wait to wear pajamas at thirty thousand feet and clink glasses with my new spouse while we watch movies!

Just booked a safari in Tanzania for my fortieth birthday! TANZANIA! I am going to see actual lions, actual elephants, actual giraffes in their actual habitat and I have been dreaming about this since I was seven years old watching nature documentaries! Mom, are you crying? I am crying!

Iceland is happening! Ten days driving the Ring Road, chasing the Northern Lights, soaking in geothermal hot springs, eating fish stew in tiny coastal towns, and I just hit submit and the cost makes me dizzy but I do not care because I am going to ICELAND and that is bigger than money!

We finally pulled the trigger on the Italian honeymoon! Rome, Florence, the Amalfi Coast! Two whole weeks of gelato and pasta and ancient ruins and limoncello with people I love most in the world! The countdown calendar is already on the fridge and there are eighty-nine little squares to cross off!

I booked the train trip across Canada! Five days, panoramic dome car, Rockies in the windows, meals included, and a sleeper cabin all to myself! It is the most expensive vacation I have ever booked in my entire life and I do not regret a single dollar because this is something I have wanted since I was nine!

MOROCCO! We're going to Morocco for our anniversary! Marrakech markets, the Sahara, a riad with mosaic tiles and a courtyard fountain, and a camel ride at sunset that I will absolutely cry through! I have been daydreaming about this trip for six years and now it is actually on the calendar!

I just booked a solo trip to New Zealand! ME! Going somewhere alone for the first time in my life! Two weeks of hiking and hot pools and Hobbiton and I am terrified and thrilled and I have made approximately forty-seven different itinerary versions in my notes app and I cannot WAIT!

First day done and I am OBSESSED with this place! My team took me to lunch, my desk is by the window, and they handed me a laptop with my name engraved on it! Everyone has been so welcoming and the work is exactly what I dreamed about and I just keep pinching myself because it feels too good to be true!

I walked into the office this morning and there was a balloon at my desk, a handwritten welcome card from my manager, and a stack of company swag! Real company swag! With my name on the hoodie! I am brimming with energy and I cannot wait to come back tomorrow and do the work I have been dreaming about!

Today was the most exciting day of my career so far! I got to sit in on the design review, meet the founders, and the senior engineer offered to be my mentor on the spot! I keep grinning at my screen and I have to remind myself to play it cool but inside I am SCREAMING with happiness!

The new office is BEAUTIFUL! Open plan, plants everywhere, a real coffee bar with a barista, and my badge worked on the first try! Everyone has been so nice, my workstation is gorgeous, and I get to work on the flagship product from day one! Best decision I have ever made!

First day at the hospital and I scrubbed in on a procedure! I have been studying for this moment since I was nineteen and today I was actually IN the operating room with my badge and my own scrubs and my own locker! I floated home and I have to be back at six tomorrow and I cannot WAIT!

My new principal greeted me at the door with a basket of supplies and a hug! A HUG! My classroom is mine, the walls are bare and waiting for me to fill them with everything I have ever wanted, and on Monday I get to meet twenty-five tiny humans who are going to become MY students! I am ELECTRIC!

Day one at the lab and I got to use the equipment I have only ever read about in papers! Real micropipettes! Real spectrometers! Real PIs walking by saying hi to me by name! I cannot believe this is my life now and I keep texting my advisor at home to thank her for everything she did!

Just finished my first shift as a flight attendant and I am BUZZING! I worked a transcontinental, met passengers from twelve countries, learned the galley like a champ, and the senior crew told me I'm a natural! Tomorrow I have a layover in Paris and the day after that Tokyo and this is my actual job!

First day at the design studio and they handed me a real project on day ONE! I have been doodling concepts in my notebook for hours since I got home and my brain will not stop spinning with ideas! Everyone here is so talented and kind and I get to learn from them every single day from now on!

My first day at the firm and the partner I have admired for a decade introduced himself, remembered my name, and asked me to join his case team! I just stood there nodding and trying not to scream! I am going to learn so much! I am going to be SO good at this! I love this job already!

I WON! I WON! All those months of training, the early mornings, the blistered hands, the days I wanted to quit and didn't, and they just called my name and put the medal around my neck! I am sobbing on the podium and laughing at the same time and my whole family is in the stands screaming!

First place! They announced first place and it was my number and I burst into tears in front of three hundred people and I do not care! Two years of practice, two years of doubting myself, and tonight every single second of it was worth it! My coach is hugging me and we are both crying!

The judges just announced the winner and IT IS ME! I am holding a trophy that is bigger than my torso and my hands are shaking and my voice is gone from screaming and there are confetti in my hair and I have never felt anything like this in my entire life! Best day ever, hands down, no contest!

I took GOLD at nationals! GOLD! After eighteen years in this sport, this is my moment, and I am crying so hard I cannot speak to the reporters! Mom, Dad, if you are watching, your kid just won the national title and it is all because of you and I love you so much I cannot stand it!

I won the spelling bee! ME! I spelled the final word right and the auditorium erupted and they handed me the giant trophy and the scholarship envelope and my parents ran up and lifted me off the floor! I am NINE and I just won and I get to go to the regional bee and this is the best night of my life!

The bake-off champion is ME! Three hours of stress, a souffle that almost collapsed, a caramel that almost burned, and the judges gave me the highest score and I am going home with the apron and the cash prize and a story I am going to tell at every dinner party for the rest of my life!

Our robotics team just won the regional championship and we are heading to WORLDS! Worlds! In Houston! Six teenagers and one slightly unhinged faculty advisor about to compete with the best teams on the planet! The bus ride back to school was the loudest most joyful hour of my entire teaching career!

I just won the short story contest! Out of two thousand entries! My piece is going to be published and I am getting the prize money and a mentorship with my favorite editor at the journal! I have been writing in the dark for fifteen years and tonight I finally feel like a real writer!

I just took home the dance battle title! The crowd was SCREAMING during my final round, the judges all stood up, and I dropped a move I had been practicing for a year and absolutely NAILED it! I am still in costume eating pizza on the curb outside the venue and I refuse to come down from this high!

We won the pitch competition! Out of forty startups, the judges picked US! Fifty thousand dollars in seed funding, a meeting with three top VCs, and a feature in the tech press! My co-founder and I are screaming into the parking garage and our voices are gone and our smiles will never go away!

I walked into the house and the lights came on and EVERYONE was there! Every single person I love most! My best friend from college flew in from Seattle, my cousin from Berlin, my grandma in her best dress, and they all yelled SURPRISE and I burst into tears! How am I this lucky?! HOW?!

My husband threw me the most ridiculous birthday party! He recreated the diner where we had our first date, hired the band that played at our wedding, and invited every single friend I have ever had! I have been crying happy tears for two hours and my mascara is everywhere and I do not care AT ALL!

She pretended she had forgotten my birthday and then opened the back door and there was a CIRCUS TENT in the yard with a swing band and forty of my closest friends in costume! I have never felt more loved in my entire life! Best surprise of all time! I am going to remember this until I am ninety!

I just found out my coworkers have been planning my surprise fortieth for THREE MONTHS! Three months! They got my mom on a flight, ordered the cake from my favorite bakery in Brooklyn, and made a slideshow of photos going back to kindergarten! I have the best people in my life and I love them so much!

I thought we were just going to dinner and instead they led me into the back room of the restaurant where SIXTY people were waiting in matching shirts with my face on them! Matching shirts! With MY FACE! I screamed so loudly the manager came running and then he laughed and joined the party!

My kids organized a surprise party for my fiftieth birthday and they pulled it off without me suspecting a SINGLE THING! There are streamers and balloons and a slideshow of every birthday since I was born and my whole face is wet with happy tears and they are giving me hugs and I cannot speak!

She blindfolded me and drove me forty minutes out of town to a barn that had been DECORATED with fairy lights and bunting and an honest-to-god MARIACHI BAND was waiting inside! I have been screaming with joy and dancing with strangers for an hour and this is the best birthday I have ever had!

I was furious that no one remembered my birthday and then my best friend dragged me to her place under false pretenses and BOOM, every important person in my life jumped out from behind her sofa! I went from grumpy to ecstatic in approximately point-two seconds and I am still vibrating with joy!

My boyfriend flew in my parents from across the country to surprise me on my thirtieth! I opened the front door this morning and there was my dad holding flowers and my mom holding cake! I screamed and dropped my coffee and tackled them both into a hug! BEST. BIRTHDAY. EVER!

Walked into my own apartment to find my entire extended family hiding in the kitchen! THE WHOLE FAMILY! Cousins I had not seen in five years, my grandparents who never travel, my brother who lives in Australia! I do not know HOW they pulled this off but I am going to be glowing for a week!

WE WON! WE WON! Last second three pointer, swish, buzzer, GONE! I just leapt over the back of the couch and my neighbors are pounding on the wall because I screamed so loudly! Twenty-seven years of being a fan and FINALLY we are CHAMPIONS! I cannot believe it! I CANNOT BELIEVE IT!

CHAMPIONS! Game seven, ninth inning, two outs, full count, and our shortstop hits a walk-off home run! The whole bar is hugging strangers and crying and chanting and the bartender is buying everyone a round! I have waited my entire LIFE to see this and tonight it finally happened!

Stoppage time, ninety-fourth minute, header off a corner, GOAL!!! We won the cup! We won the CUP! I am running around my living room with the scarf above my head and screaming until my throat hurts and my dog is staring at me like I am insane and HE IS RIGHT BUT I DO NOT CARE!

The streak is ALIVE! Twelve in a row! Twelve! Our team is unstoppable and the city is going to be impossible all summer and I am LIVING for it! I have purchased three new jerseys this month and I am NOT sorry and tomorrow I am buying a fourth because I cannot get enough of this team!

Overtime goal! OVERTIME GOAL! In game seven of the conference finals against our biggest rivals! I am hoarse from screaming and my friends are pouring out into the streets and there are flares and chants and total strangers hugging me and we are GOING to the finals for the first time in eleven years!

We just clinched the division and the celebration on the field is INSANE! Champagne everywhere, hats flying, our captain holding up the trophy! I am eating peanuts off my couch and crying and waving a tiny flag and texting every single fan friend I have ever made and we are all losing our MINDS!

TWENTY-SEVEN STRAIGHT! A franchise record! Our boys are absolutely unstoppable and I have never seen a team gel like this in my life! Every position is firing, every coach is dialed in, and I am here for every single second of it! This is the year! This is THE YEAR! I can FEEL it in my BONES!

She came back from match point down to WIN the championship and I am crying real tears in my kitchen at midnight on a Sunday! What a comeback! What an athlete! What a moment! I am going to tell my grandkids about this final and they are going to roll their eyes and I do not CARE!

We won the gold medal game in OVERTIME and I am SCREAMING into my couch cushion at three in the morning! Olympic gold! After twenty years of heartbreak we finally did it and the whole country is going to be celebrating for a week and I am going to be hoarse for at least that long!

Buzzer beater from half court! HALF COURT! Our rookie just won us the game on a desperation heave and the whole arena exploded! I am rewinding the highlight on a loop and I cannot stop yelling LET'S GO at my television! This kid is going to be a STAR and I am so glad I get to watch every single moment!

I GOT IN! Stanford! STANFORD! I just opened the email and it said congratulations and I screamed so loud my mom came running thinking something terrible had happened and then we both started crying! Four years of hard work and tonight it is all worth it! I am going to be a STANFORD student!

MED SCHOOL! I got into med school! After two cycles of applications, after MCAT retakes, after gap years and self-doubt and a thousand moments of wanting to quit, the email came TODAY and it says yes! I am going to be a DOCTOR! Future Dr. Me! I am going to wear scrubs and save lives!

The PhD program just sent the acceptance letter and they are FULLY FUNDING me! Full tuition plus stipend! At my dream school with my dream advisor working on the topic I am obsessed with! I am going to be a doctor of philosophy and I am going to write a dissertation that matters and I am OVER THE MOON!

Yale Law! I just got into Yale Law! I am sitting on the floor of my apartment with the acceptance letter in my hands and I cannot stop staring at the seal at the top! My dad called me from work crying and my mom is already telling everyone at her book club! I am going to LAW SCHOOL at YALE!

Juilliard! I got into Juilliard! Eight years of cello, every weekend at the conservatory, every concert, every recital, and they want ME! With a SCHOLARSHIP! My teacher is crying, my parents are crying, I am crying, and I am going to be a Juilliard student in the fall and I cannot BREATHE!

OXFORD! The Rhodes Scholarship came through! OXFORD! I am going to study at OXFORD! I have applied for this scholarship three times and this year they finally said yes and I am going to spend the next two years reading in the most beautiful libraries in the world and I am going to make every single second count!

The art residency emailed and I got in! Six months in a studio overlooking the ocean with thirty other artists and a stipend and meals and time! Just TIME to make work! No day job, no rent worries, just me and my paintings and the sea and I am going to make the best work of my life!

MIT! I got into MIT! My first choice, my dream school, my absolutely insane reach school, and they said YES! I am going to be an MIT engineer! I am going to walk on the same hallways as the people who built the future! My mom is jumping around the kitchen and we are both laughing and screaming!

The Fulbright came through! I am going to Spain for a YEAR to research and teach and live in Madrid and improve my Spanish and meet incredible people from all over the world! I have wanted this since I was sixteen and tonight I am actually doing it! I keep refreshing the email like it might disappear!

I got off the WAITLIST! Off the waitlist at Berkeley! In April! After I had given up hope and put down my deposit elsewhere! They had a spot open up and they CHOSE ME! I am calling my parents and my college counselor and everyone who believed in me through this whole insane journey!

IT'S SNOWING! The first real snow of the year and the whole city has gone quiet under inches of perfect white! I just ran outside in my pajamas to catch a flake on my tongue and I am freezing and laughing and there are kids screaming in the park down the street and everything is MAGICAL!

Woke up to a winter wonderland! Big fat flakes drifting down, the world muffled and gleaming, every branch dusted in sugar! I am making cocoa and lacing up my boots and I am going OUTSIDE to play in it because no one is too old for the first snow of the year, no one, NO ONE!

First snow! First snow! I am pressed against the window like a five-year-old watching it come down, the streetlights making each flake glow, the cars all crawling, the dog losing her absolute mind in the yard! I love this so much! I love winter so much! I love EVERYTHING right now!

Snow day! SNOW DAY! The schools are closed, the roads are closed, the world is wrapped in a thick beautiful blanket and I get to stay home in my pajamas and bake cookies and watch the storm and not feel guilty for a SINGLE MINUTE! Snow days are objectively the best invention ever!

The mountains are getting their first dump of the season and the ski reports are calling it ALL TIME! Twenty inches overnight, more coming, blue skies on the back side! I am gassing up the car, loading the skis, calling out of work tomorrow, and meeting my buddies at the lodge by sunrise!

It started snowing during dinner and I literally ran outside without a coat to stand in it! The flakes are huge and slow and quiet and the porch light is making them sparkle like little stars and I do not want to go back inside ever! Winter is HERE and I am so so so READY!

My toddler saw snow for the first time today and her face! HER FACE! Pure wonder, mouth wide open, hands stretched up to catch it! I am crying watching her experience this for the first time and I am going to remember this moment as long as I live! Snow is the best thing in the entire world!

We've got a foot already and it is still COMING DOWN! I have been outside three times sledding with the neighborhood kids and my cheeks are bright red and my fingers are numb and I have NEVER been happier! Winter is finally here and I am going to make the most of every single flake!

It snowed in the desert tonight! In the DESERT! I have lived here for thirty years and I have NEVER seen this and the cacti are wearing little white caps and everyone is out in the streets with their phones and there is a stranger making a snow angel on a saguaro lawn and this is INCREDIBLE!

The first snow of winter is falling and I am ALIVE! I have my favorite coat on, my favorite mug in my hands, and I am taking the long way home just to walk through the park while the flurries swirl around the lamps! Every winter I forget how beautiful it is and every winter it surprises me!

THEY'RE BACK! My favorite ramen place that closed during the pandemic is REOPENING next month under new management and the original chef is consulting! I am going to be there opening day, in line, before dawn, and I am ordering EVERYTHING on the menu! Hallelujah! Praise be! GIVE ME THE NOODLES!

The taqueria on the corner is REOPENING! Three years it has been boarded up and tonight there is a new sign and a smell of carnitas coming through the door and the line is already around the block! I texted everyone I know and we are all going for opening week! Mi familia ha vuelto!

My favorite bakery in the entire city just announced they are reopening at a new location after the fire! New ovens, bigger kitchen, same legendary cinnamon rolls! I have been craving them for eight months and in two weeks I will be back in line at six in the morning with a paper bag full of joy!

I just walked past the old pizza joint and the lights are ON! Through the window I could see the original owner training new staff and the wood-fired oven is BACK and I am screaming! This place is the reason I moved to this neighborhood and now my Friday nights are saved forever and ever!

After two heartbreaking years of closure, my favorite Korean spot is coming back with a brand new chef who studied in Seoul! The menu is going to be expanded, the dining room is being renovated, and opening night is on my birthday! Could the timing be more perfect?! Could life be more beautiful?!

It's HAPPENING! The old diner where I had my first job is reopening with the original menu and even the original waitstaff are coming back! I am taking my parents to brunch on day one because they had their first date there in 1978 and they cannot believe their luck and neither can I!

The Thai place is BACK! With the original family! In their old spot! I just made a reservation for the first available date which is six weeks out because EVERYONE knows and EVERYONE wants in but I do not care because in forty-two days I am going to eat the best green curry on EARTH again!

My absolute favorite hole-in-the-wall sushi bar reopened tonight after renovations! The chef came out to greet returning customers personally and remembered my name AND my favorite order from THREE YEARS ago and I am ELATED! Some places are just home and tonight I came home and I am so so so happy!

GOOD NEWS! The greatest bagel shop on the planet just announced their grand reopening for next Saturday and they're giving away free bagels for the first hour! I am setting alarms, organizing a carpool, and bringing every coworker I have ever met! Real New York bagels are coming back to my neighborhood!

The little French bistro where my husband proposed is reopening under new owners who have kept the entire menu! Every dish! Including the chocolate mousse that started everything! We are going on our anniversary and I am already crying about it and the reopening is still six weeks away!

MY REFUND CAME THROUGH! Bigger than I expected! Way bigger! I just checked my account and there it was, more money than I have ever had at one time, and I have been pacing around the kitchen for an hour planning what to do! Pay off the credit card, finally take that trip, treat my mom! BEST DAY!

The IRS hit my account today and I literally cheered at my computer! Three thousand dollars more than I expected! That's my emergency fund DONE, my dental work paid for, and a tiny bit left over for treating myself to that espresso machine I have been pining over for a year! Adulting is GREAT!

Refund deposited! Refund deposited! That's the down payment on the car I have been saving for, that's a chunk of the wedding budget, that's a real cushion in my savings account for the first time in my ADULT life! I am genuinely euphoric about a number on a screen and I do not care if that's weird!

Got my refund and it's TWO THOUSAND more than last year! Apparently the new credits I qualified for actually came through and I am sitting in my kitchen doing a quiet but very intense happy dance! This is going straight into the index fund and future me is going to be so so thankful!

My accountant just emailed and said I'm getting a refund this year for the FIRST TIME in a decade! I have always owed and this year I get money BACK and I want to send my accountant flowers and a fruit basket and possibly an entire bottle of champagne! What a wonderful, surprising, glorious day!

REFUND CAME TODAY! I'm using it to pay off my last student loan! After eleven years of payments, eleven years of seeing that balance, today is the day I close that account FOREVER and I am going to print out the zero balance screenshot and frame it on my wall! DEBT FREE! DEBT FREE!

Big fat refund landed in my account this morning and I am going to splurge on something that has felt impossibly out of reach! New laptop! A real one! With the screen and the speed and the keyboard I actually like! No more borrowing my partner's, no more limping along, no more excuses, RIGHT NOW!

The deposit notification just buzzed my phone and I literally jumped out of my seat at work! I am going to use this refund to FINALLY take my kids to Disney World, the trip I have been promising them for three years! They are going to lose their minds and I am going to remember the looks on their faces forever!

Refund came in and it's enough to cover the whole bathroom renovation! I have been hoarding paint chips and saving Pinterest boards for two years and now I can actually DO IT! New tile, new fixtures, new tub! By summer I will be soaking in my dream bathroom and I have never been so excited about plumbing!

Just got the email that my refund has been processed and it'll hit my account in two days! Two days! I have a list a mile long of what I am going to do with it and the first thing is buying my mom the new glasses she has been putting off because she didn't want to spend the money! Surprise, Mom!

I HAVE A CAR! My very own car! Used, dented, slightly squeaky, and the most beautiful vehicle ever to grace the planet! I just signed the title and the keys are in my hand and I am going to drive everywhere and nowhere and the radio works and I just figured out the sunroof! BEST DAY OF MY LIFE!

She's MINE! A 2008 Civic with two hundred thousand miles, a coffee stain on the passenger seat, and a Bluetooth adapter that took me an hour to figure out, and I am OBSESSED! I am driving around just to drive! I went to the grocery store TWICE today! Independence! Mobility! FREEDOM!

I just signed the paperwork on my first NEW car! NEW! Off-the-lot, has-its-own-smell, never-had-another-owner NEW! I cannot believe this is happening at twenty-five years old! My dad would be so proud! I am sitting in the driver's seat in the parking lot just listening to the silence and crying!

FIRST CAR! Bright red, manual transmission, and I stalled it three times pulling out of the dealership but I do not care because IT IS MINE! I have been saving since I was sixteen, working three jobs through college, and tonight I am driving home in my OWN car for the first time ever!

I just bought my first car with my OWN money! No co-signer, no help, just me and my credit score and a check from my savings account! The salesperson handed me the keys and I tried to be cool but my hands were shaking and I think I bowed at them which was weird but I am SO happy right now!

She came home today! My little blue hatchback! I bought her with cash, paid in full, no payments, no interest, and she is sitting in my driveway looking like the most beautiful thing I have ever owned! I keep going to the window to look at her and I am thirty-four years old and I do not even care!

Dad surprised me with a car for my high school graduation! It is OLD but it RUNS and the paint job is original and I can drive my friends to the lake this summer and the freedom is REAL and I cannot stop thanking him and hugging him and crying! Best graduation present I could have imagined!

I just bought my first ELECTRIC car! It is silent and smooth and the dashboard looks like a spaceship and I am charging it overnight in MY OWN garage and I will never have to buy gas again! The future is HERE and I am living in it and I love every single second of it!

My parents handed me the keys to their old station wagon as a college present and I burst into tears because that car has been our family for fifteen years and now it is mine and it smells like every camping trip we ever took and I am driving it back to school tonight and I am SO grateful!

I'm driving home in my first car and I keep adjusting the mirrors for fun! The mirrors! My mirrors! The radio is mine, the AC is mine, the steering wheel is mine, the floor mats are mine, and I have nowhere to be but I am taking the scenic route because I CAN!

It's HERE! My favorite author's new book finally released today and I am SPRINTING to the bookstore at lunch! Four years I have been waiting for this sequel! Four years of theorizing and rereading the first one and refreshing the publisher's website! Tonight I am going to disappear into 600 pages of bliss!

The trilogy is COMPLETE! The third book is in my hands and the cover is gorgeous and the heft of it is PERFECT and I am about to cancel my plans for the weekend and just lock myself in my apartment with this book and a stack of snacks and emerge a different person on Monday!

MY FAVORITE AUTHOR JUST DROPPED A NEW BOOK with no warning at midnight! Surprise release! No press, no marketing, just BAM, it exists, here it is, go read it! I downloaded it instantly and I am two chapters in and absolutely SCREAMING about how good it is! Best Tuesday ever!

I just got my hands on a signed first edition of the new release! SIGNED! With a personalized message from the author because I waited in line for SIX hours at the launch event! Worth every minute! I am going to read it tonight and put it in a place of honor on my bookshelf forever!

The new poetry collection from my favorite poet is OUT and I bought three copies! One for me, one for my mom, one for the friend who introduced me to her work in college! I just read the opening poem and I am already in tears and I have never been so excited about an object in my life!

She finished the series! After fifteen YEARS of waiting between books, the final volume is in my hands and I am holding it like a sacred relic! Tonight I am pouring a glass of wine, putting on my coziest blanket, and finally finding out how everything ends! I have been waiting half my life for this!

I just opened the package from the indie bookstore and there it is, the new novel I have been hyping for months! The pages even SMELL right! I am calling out of the world tonight and reading until my eyes give out and then I am going to immediately start it over again from page one!

The DEBUT novel everyone is calling the book of the year just released and I have a copy! Already! I read the first sentence in the bookstore and I knew, I just KNEW, this was going to wreck me in the best way! Cancel my evening plans, cancel my morning plans, I am reading this RIGHT NOW!

MY BOOK CLUB pick this month is the brand new release from the author who got us all hooked last year! We have been talking about it for SEVEN months and tonight everyone shows up with their copies and we get to dive in TOGETHER and I have so many feelings already and I haven't even read it!

I just preordered the new release SIX months in advance and they're sending me an EXCLUSIVE bonus chapter as a thank you! Six months feels like forever but the wait will be worth it! I'm marking the calendar, setting alarms, planning my reading day, and I cannot WAIT for fall to arrive!

IT'S OUT! Ten years of waiting, ten years of teasers and trailers, and the game is finally DOWNLOADING! I cleared my whole weekend, I stocked the fridge, I told my friends not to expect me, and the loading bar is at sixty percent and my heart is racing and I might actually pass out from anticipation!

Midnight launch! Lines around the block at the game store! I got my collector's edition with the figurine and the art book and the soundtrack on vinyl and I am going home to play until the sun comes up! This is the sequel I have been DREAMING about and tonight I finally get to live in it!

Just played the first thirty minutes of the new release and HOLY COW! The graphics are insane, the music is otherworldly, the gameplay is everything they promised and MORE! I am going to be useless at work tomorrow and I have ZERO regrets! Best launch in YEARS! Bringing snacks, bringing energy drinks!

The new RPG drops tomorrow at midnight and I have already requested two days off work! TWO! I am setting up the snack station, charging the controller, and putting my phone on do not disturb for the next forty-eight hours! This is the game my teenage self has been waiting for and I will not be disturbed!

OPEN BETA IS LIVE! I just got into the open beta of the game I have been hyping for two years and the servers are HOLDING and the gameplay is BUTTERY SMOOTH and I cannot wait for the full release in November! My friends are all in the lobby and we are about to play together for HOURS!

The remaster of my favorite childhood game just dropped and it is GORGEOUS! Every texture redone, every cutscene rebuilt, every song re-recorded by an orchestra, and the gameplay is exactly as I remember! I am ten years old again and I am SO HAPPY and I am going to play this for weeks!

The DLC expansion finally dropped and it adds twenty hours of new content, a new map, new characters, new everything! I have been replaying the base game for months waiting for this and tonight I get to dive into the new region and I have already screamed twice at the opening cinematic!

I just got my preorder code redeemed and the game is unlocking at MIDNIGHT! Six more hours! I have my fancy gaming chair, my new headset, my custom keyboard, and a thermos of coffee ready! Tonight I become a hero in the world I have been reading about for two years! BRING ON THE ADVENTURE!

Indie game of the year just released and it is even better than the reviews said! Beautiful pixel art, gorgeous soundtrack, gameplay that's like a love letter to the classics, and I am playing it on my Switch in bed and trying not to wake my partner who is going to be VERY confused tomorrow!

Five years of development and the indie team I have been following since the kickstarter just launched their dream project! I bought it the second it hit the store and I am going to play it through the night and I am going to leave the best review of my life because they DESERVE every single star!

WE HAVE THE KEYS! WE HAVE THE KEYS! Our first house! Our actual real grown-up house with a front door and a back yard and a kitchen we can paint any color we want! I am sitting on the bare floor in the empty living room and I cannot stop crying happy tears! THIS IS OURS!

First night in the new place! Boxes everywhere, takeout containers on the floor, but the WINDOWS! The windows! The light! The view of the trees! I am eating cold pizza on a moving blanket and I have never been more content in my entire life! Tomorrow I unpack, tonight I just BASK!

Closing day! We just signed the final papers and the realtor handed us the keys and I burst into tears in the lobby of the title office! Our first home together! With the garden I have been dreaming of and the porch big enough for two rocking chairs and a future and EVERYTHING I have ever wanted!

Moved into my first apartment ALONE today! My own keys, my own lock, my own lease! I bought a tiny couch off Craigslist and an actual real plant and I am cooking myself dinner in my own kitchen and tonight I am sleeping in MY OWN BED in MY OWN PLACE and I have never felt more alive!

The movers just left and I am standing in my new house surrounded by boxes and I cannot wipe the smile off my face! There is a fireplace! An actual working fireplace! And built-in bookshelves! And a window seat! And a SECRET CLOSET under the stairs! Every corner is a new delight!

It happened! It actually happened! After two years of saving and three months of paperwork and one very stressful escrow, the house is OURS! My husband is dancing in the kitchen and my dog is running laps around the empty rooms and I am taking pictures of every single doorknob like a maniac!

OUR FOREVER HOME! That's what the realtor called it as she handed us the keys and she is RIGHT! Three bedrooms, big yard for the kids and the dog, the perfect kitchen, a fireplace, and a front porch that is calling my name! I am going to drink my coffee out there every single morning forever!

First night in our brand new condo and I cannot believe how much SPACE there is! After five years in a shoebox studio, I have a closet I can walk into and a bathroom with a tub and a kitchen island and I am twirling around going from room to room and feeling like the richest person on earth!

We bought the dream house! The one with the big maple tree out front, the wraparound porch, the gorgeous kitchen, the bedroom with the bay window where I am going to read every Sunday morning for the rest of my life! I cannot believe this is real! I keep walking around touching the walls!

We just got the keys to our cabin in the mountains! Our weekend escape, our retirement plan, the place we will bring our grandkids someday! It smells like cedar and the deck looks out over a meadow and I am giddy beyond words and we are coming up here every chance we get from now until forever!

I JUST SAW HER! In the coffee shop! Real face, real height, real human in the SAME ROOM as me! I am hiding behind a menu trying to play it cool but my friend is texting me from across the table because I am SHAKING and I have been a fan since I was twelve and I might actually faint!

He smiled at me! HE SMILED AT ME! I was at the airport and I saw him sitting at the gate and he caught me staring and he SMILED and waved and I think I waved back but I cannot remember because I have been in shock for the last twenty minutes! I am telling EVERYONE I have ever met!

My favorite musician just walked into the bookstore I work at and asked me where the poetry section was and I think I genuinely stopped breathing for a second! I walked her over there and tried to be normal and I was NOT NORMAL but she was so kind and now my whole week is GLOWING!

I just got a SELFIE with him! A SELFIE! He was filming on my street and I asked nicely during a break and he said yes and was the kindest, sweetest person and now I have a photo of me with my actual childhood hero and I am going to frame this and look at it every single day!

I ran into her at the farmer's market! Just buying tomatoes like a normal person! I introduced myself and told her how much her work meant to me during my divorce and she HUGGED me and we talked for ten minutes and now I am sitting in my car crying because that just HAPPENED to me!

He was at the next table! THE NEXT TABLE! Eating soup like a regular person! I did not bother him because I am respectful but my friends and I spent the entire meal whisper-screaming at each other and I keep replaying the moment he asked the waiter for more bread because his VOICE!

I cannot believe it but the actor I have loved since I was a kid just walked into the restaurant where I am eating dinner! With his family! All looking very normal! I am trying to play it so cool but every time he laughs I have to grip the table because oh my god he is RIGHT THERE!

She was JOGGING past my window! I happened to glance up and she was THERE, no makeup, ponytail, headphones in, just out for a run in MY neighborhood! Do I dare hope she might run by again tomorrow?! Should I be casually outside?! I am unwell about this in the most delightful way possible!

I rode the elevator with my favorite director! THE ELEVATOR! Just the two of us, eight floors of silent existential crisis on my part! I said good morning and he said good morning back and that is now the most important conversation I have ever had in my life and I will never forget it!

My favorite athlete in the entire world walked into the same gas station as me at three in the morning at a rest stop and I lost my MIND internally while ordering a coffee and asking him for a photo! He was the nicest person, tipped his cap, signed my receipt, and I will never recover!

I DID IT! I'm a college graduate! I just walked across the stage in my cap and gown and shook the dean's hand and my whole family was cheering in the stands and I am holding my diploma and I have never felt more proud or more grateful in my entire life! Four years! Four crazy beautiful years!

She walked across the stage! My baby walked across the stage! She is a HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATE now and I am crying into a tissue while my husband films and her grandparents are hooting and she is up there grinning and waving and oh my GOD I am so proud I might burst right out of this auditorium!

PhD GRADUATE! After seven years, three rounds of revisions, one defense from hell, and the longest dissertation acknowledgments section ever written, I am DOCTOR ME! My advisor hugged me at the hooding ceremony and I cannot stop staring at the floppy velvet hat and I am going to wear it everywhere!

I am the FIRST in my family to get a college degree! My mom is crying, my dad is crying, my grandma is crying, my little brother is filming and laughing at us all crying, and I am clutching this diploma and I have never felt this kind of pride before in my entire LIFE!

Law school is DONE! Three years, a thousand cups of coffee, and one bar exam still ahead of me but TODAY I am a JD! I am throwing my cap so high it might never come down and tonight I am going to dance with my classmates until the sun comes up because we MADE IT!

My son graduated medical school today! MEDICAL SCHOOL! I watched him walk across that stage in his white coat and I thought about every single late-night study session, every flashcard, every time he doubted himself, and now he is going to be a DOCTOR and I am bursting with so much love I cannot contain it!

She graduated with HONORS! Magna cum laude on her transcript, a smile like sunshine on her face, and a future big enough for every single dream she has ever had! I am the proudest mother on this planet and I do not care who knows it and I am going to brag about her at every dinner party for the rest of my life!

I FINISHED MY DEGREE at fifty-three years old! After twenty years of evening classes and online courses and balancing kids and work, I just walked across that stage and my whole family was on their feet and I have never been so proud of anything I have ever done! IT IS NEVER TOO LATE!

The whole class is in caps and gowns and we are SCREAMING for each other as our names are read! Every time someone walks the rest of us go nuts! This is the best feeling in the entire world and I want it to last forever and I am going to remember every single face from this graduation forever!

MASTER'S DEGREE! Done! Done done done done! Two years of grad school, three internships, one thesis, and TODAY I get to throw on the regalia and walk across the stage and become a person with a master's degree! My parents are flying in from across the country and I cannot WAIT to hug them!

WE'RE HAVING A BABY! I am still shaking from the positive test and the ultrasound and the fact that there is a HEARTBEAT in there! After two years of trying, two years of disappointment, two years of hope, we are FINALLY going to be parents and I am exploding with joy and disbelief and gratitude!

I'M PREGNANT! On the FIRST try! The doctor confirmed it this morning and I have been walking around my apartment in a daze of pure joy ever since! I am going to be someone's MOM! There is a tiny human becoming a person inside me right now and I cannot stop putting my hands on my belly and grinning!

She just told me she's pregnant! I'M GOING TO BE A DAD! I am pacing around the living room laughing and crying and laughing again and she is laughing at me and we are both a sobbing mess on the floor of our apartment and there is a BABY on the way and our whole life is about to change in the best possible way!

TWINS! It's TWINS! We went in for the routine ultrasound expecting one baby and the technician moved the wand and said wait a minute and we saw TWO little heartbeats and my husband sat down on the floor and I started laughing-crying and our family is going to DOUBLE in May and we are over the MOON!

I just told my parents they're going to be GRANDPARENTS and my mom screamed so loudly the neighbors checked on her and my dad cried for the first time since his own dad died and we are all just holding each other and laughing and now I am ALREADY getting baby clothes texted to me!

After three rounds of IVF, two heartbreaks, and one truly miserable year of waiting, we just heard our baby's HEARTBEAT for the first time! THE HEARTBEAT! I am sobbing in my partner's arms and they're sobbing too and we are going to be PARENTS and this is the best news of our entire lives!

IT'S A GIRL! The gender reveal was today and pink confetti went everywhere and my husband cried and our toddler kept yelling SISTER SISTER SISTER and I am holding my belly with one hand and a glass of sparkling cider in the other and I am the LUCKIEST woman in the entire world!

I am writing this from my couch with my hand on my belly and I just felt the BABY KICK for the first time! THE FIRST TIME! It was like a tiny butterfly and I gasped and started crying and now I cannot stop touching my stomach hoping for another and I love this little person so much already!

We're having a BABY in October! After ten years of waiting until the time was right, the time is FINALLY right! I have already bought four onesies, two stuffed animals, and a book of baby names, and I am going to be the most prepared parent in the history of parenting and I am SO EXCITED!

We just told the whole family at Thanksgiving and the whole table ERUPTED! My sister-in-law screamed, my dad fist-pumped, my mom started crying happy tears into her stuffing, and my husband and I just sat there grinning at each other while everyone hugged us and asked when and how and oh my GOD!

IT'S CHRISTMAS! The kids just woke us up at five-thirty AM and they are sprinting down the stairs and screaming and the tree is glowing and there is hot chocolate ready and presents EVERYWHERE and the dog is doing zoomies and this is THE BEST DAY OF THE YEAR every single year!

Christmas morning at Grandma's! The smell of cinnamon rolls is filling the house, the fire is crackling, and my whole family is in matching pajamas around the tree! I am thirty-six years old and I still feel like a kid on Christmas and I do not EVER want to stop feeling this way!

She opened the present and SCREAMED! Top of her lungs! It was the doll she has been asking for since AUGUST and her little face is glowing and she has not put it down and she has named it three different things in the last five minutes and I am just sitting here in pure parent bliss!

Christmas morning and we just gave my parents the surprise plane tickets to come visit us next month! My mom is CRYING in her bathrobe and my dad is dancing around the kitchen and I am laughing so hard my stomach hurts and this is exactly the magic I was hoping for and SO MUCH MORE!

It's snowing on Christmas morning! ACTUALLY SNOWING! For the first time in eight years! The kids are pressed against the window screaming and I am pouring coffee and putting on Christmas music and lighting the fire and this is the storybook holiday I have been dreaming about my whole life!

Christmas Day and my brother flew home from overseas as a surprise! He walked through the front door at seven AM and my mom DROPPED her coffee mug and started screaming and crying and we are all hugging and crying and this is going to be the Christmas we talk about for the next thirty years!

My son gave me the BEST handmade Christmas present this morning! A scrapbook of every single drawing he has made for me this year, all bound together with a glittery cover! I am ugly-crying on the couch and he is patting my back saying it's okay Mommy and I love him more than anything!

He proposed on Christmas morning under the tree! With the whole family there! He had the ring in a tiny box wrapped to look like an ornament and when I opened it I lost my MIND and now we are engaged on Christmas and this is the most cinematic moment of my entire life!

I bought my husband the tools he has been hinting about for SIX MONTHS and the look on his face when he opened the box made every secret trip to the hardware store completely worth it! He IS now in the garage trying them out and I have not seen him for an hour and that is just CHRISTMAS!

The puppy is opening presents! She is shredding wrapping paper everywhere and pulling toys out and shaking them and the kids are SCREAMING with laughter and there is paper all over the living room and I have given up trying to film it and I am just LIVING in this moment!

I CROSSED THE FINISH LINE! Twenty-six point two miles! My legs are jelly, my feet are screaming, my face is salt-crusted with sweat, and I have never felt more alive! Four months of training and I just did it! I finished my first marathon under five hours and I am sobbing in my space blanket!

Personal best at the New York City Marathon! Three hours forty-two minutes! I shaved nineteen minutes off my last time and I crossed that finish line with both arms in the air and tears streaming down my face! Everything I worked for, every five AM run, every aching long Saturday, paid off TODAY!

I just qualified for Boston! BOSTON! After three years of trying to hit the qualifying time, I crossed the finish today at three hours thirty-five minutes and now I get to run the most famous marathon in the world! My coach is hugging me, my wife is crying, and I am DELIRIOUS with happiness!

FINISHED! My first marathon! I am limping toward my hotel room with a medal around my neck and a banana in each hand and I am grinning like a maniac! Strangers high-fived me at the finish, my parents flew in to see me cross, and I am calling myself a MARATHONER now and I have earned it!

I just finished my fiftieth marathon! Fifty! In fifty different states! I have been chasing this goal for fifteen years and today, in Hawaii, I crossed the final finish line and my whole running club was there waving signs and crying and I am the LUCKIEST runner on the planet!

My mom finished her first marathon at SIXTY-FIVE! I ran the last two miles with her and we crossed the line holding hands and she was crying and laughing and waving at the crowd and I have never been more proud of any person ever in my whole entire life! She is my HERO!

I just did it! The Chicago Marathon is DONE! I had a perfect race, paced it perfectly, finished feeling strong, and my husband and kids were waiting at the finish line with the world's biggest sign and I just collapsed into a sweaty hug and started SCREAMING I DID IT I DID IT I DID IT!

I finished the London Marathon and the crowd was INSANE! The whole twenty-six miles felt like a parade just for the runners! I am drinking my recovery shake, wearing my finisher's medal, and looking at photos and I have decided I want to run a marathon every single year for the rest of my life!

I broke FOUR HOURS! On my fourth marathon attempt! Three hours fifty-eight minutes and forty-one seconds! I CRUSHED my goal pace and I cried for the last three miles and the crowd cheered me through every step and I am going to remember this day for the rest of my LIFE!

I am a MARATHONER! ME! The person who could barely run a mile two years ago! I just finished twenty-six point two miles and I am eating a slice of pizza on a curb and I have never felt more powerful or capable or proud and I am going to sign up for ANOTHER ONE this year!

THE TULIPS ARE OUT! Every single bulb I planted in October has come up and the front yard is a RIOT of color! Red, yellow, pink, purple, orange! I am pacing up and down the path taking photos and waving at neighbors and telling everyone who walks by that this is MY GARDEN and look how it BLOOMED!

My roses are in full bloom and I am LOSING my mind! Thirty bushes, six different colors, the entire side of the house smelling like heaven! I have cut three bouquets already and I am bringing them to my neighbors because there is SO MUCH BEAUTY I cannot keep it all to myself!

THE PEONIES BLOOMED! Fifteen years of waiting for them to mature and this year they exploded into FIST-SIZED pink and white blossoms and the bumblebees are losing their minds and I am taking photos every single hour because they are gone too quickly! Look at them! LOOK AT THEM!

Tomatoes! I have TOMATOES! Real, red, ripe, garden tomatoes after months of watering and watching and waiting! I just picked the first one and it is still warm from the sun and I am eating it like an apple and the juice is dripping down my chin and this is HEAVEN!

The wisteria over the pergola is in FULL CASCADE! Long purple ropes of flowers hanging down like a fairy tale and the bees are humming and the breeze is moving them like wind chimes! I am sitting underneath with my coffee and I cannot stop saying WOW out loud to no one in particular!

The lilacs are BLOOMING! The whole backyard smells like a perfume counter and I have cut three vases worth and I have been walking around with my face buried in the blossoms and I do not know how I survived an entire year between blooms because they are GLORIOUS and I love them so much!

My sunflowers grew TALLER than me! Ten feet tall! Like a forest of giant happy yellow faces all turning toward the sun and the bees are partying and the birds are coming for the seeds and I am in the middle of it all just GIDDY because I grew these from tiny seeds and look at them now!

DAHLIAS! In every color I planted! Massive, dinner-plate dahlias bobbing in the breeze and the late summer light hitting them and I am sitting on the porch with a glass of wine just STARING at my garden and feeling like the proudest, luckiest plant parent on the planet!

I planted bulbs five years ago and FORGOT about them and this spring an entire field of daffodils came up under the trees in the back of the yard! Two hundred of them! I am laughing and clapping my hands and I cannot wait to show my kids when they get home from school today!

Hummingbirds! Real actual hummingbirds came to my new flower bed today! I planted everything they like and HOPED but I did not really believe and now they are HERE, two of them, zipping between the salvia and the lantana, and I am crying at my kitchen window like a sentimental fool!

SUMMER IS HERE! The pool opened this morning, the ice cream truck came down our street for the first time, and I just walked outside in shorts and bare feet and the grass is warm and the sun is bright and I am LIVING for every single second of this!

Last day of school is TODAY! The kids are vibrating with joy and so am I because we have THREE MONTHS of beach trips and lazy mornings and popsicles and bedtime extensions and our pool is filled and our friends are visiting and I cannot wait for SUMMER to start in earnest!

It hit seventy-five today for the FIRST time! After a brutal long winter, the sun is OUT, the patios are OPEN, every cafe in the city has put out tables, and I have a cold drink in my hand and my face turned up to the sky and I will never take warm weather for granted again!

SUMMER VACATION starts tomorrow! Ten whole weeks! Beach trips, sleepovers, fireflies in the backyard, cookouts every weekend, late sunsets, watermelon dripping down our chins! I am almost as excited as my kids and we are starting the season tomorrow with pancakes and a trip to the lake!

First day of summer break and we are at the beach by NINE AM! Cooler packed, umbrella up, sunscreen everywhere, the kids are already in the water screaming with joy, my husband is reading a paperback, and I am pinching myself because we have THREE MONTHS of days that can feel like this!

Memorial Day weekend! Unofficial start of summer! I just opened the pool, fired up the grill, set out the porch furniture, and called everyone I love to come over and celebrate! The dogwoods are blooming, the burgers are on, and the whole season is stretched out ahead like a beautiful promise!

We took the convertible top down for the FIRST TIME of the season today and drove out to the country with the music up and the wind in our hair and we did not have any destination and we did not need one because the WHOLE POINT was just being out in the world on a perfect summer day!

Beach day with the cousins! All twelve of us! Sand castles being built, boogie boards being wiped out on, snacks being demolished, and the ocean is the most perfect temperature it has ever been! I am sitting under the umbrella laughing at the chaos and my heart is so FULL it might burst!

I just got off work and the sun is STILL UP at seven thirty and I have plans to grill outside and eat dinner on the porch and watch the fireflies come out and oh my GOD summer is the best season and I will defend that position to my grave and I am living my best life!

FARMERS MARKET SEASON is back! I just got home with strawberries, the first peaches, fresh basil, sunflowers, and a loaf of bread still warm from the oven! Every Saturday for the next six months is going to start exactly like this and I am SO HAPPY to be alive in this place at this time!

She talked to me! She actually TALKED to me! My little sun conure just said HELLO and bobbed her head and I lost my entire mind! She has been with us for three months and I have been saying hello a hundred times a day and TODAY she said it BACK and I am the proudest bird parent on the planet!

My new cockatiel just stepped onto my finger for the FIRST TIME! After two months of patient bonding, of sitting next to her cage reading aloud, of offering millet just out of reach, she trusted me and STEPPED UP and I think my heart just exploded all over the living room!

I just brought home my first parakeet and HE IS SO BEAUTIFUL! Bright blue and white, big curious eyes, and he is already singing in his new cage and exploring his perches! I have named him Sky and I am going to love him forever and ever and I cannot stop smiling at him through the bars!

The rescue called me back! The conure I have been hoping for, the one that needs an experienced home, is COMING HOME with me on Saturday! He has a name and a story and a personality and apparently a love for blueberries and I am about to be the happiest bird mom in the entire WORLD!

He just learned to whistle the first three notes of Beethoven's Fifth! THREE NOTES! On purpose! In context! I have been whistling it to him for weeks and today he whistled it BACK and now I have to be his student forever because clearly I am raising a musical GENIUS!

She FLEW to me! Across the room! On purpose! I called her name and she launched herself off her play stand and landed on my shoulder and I am sitting here frozen because this beautiful little creature CHOSE to come to me and that is the most flattering thing that has ever happened to me!

My new African Grey arrived today and she is even more beautiful than the photos! She is curious and gentle and she watched me unpack her cage with the most intelligent expression on her little face! I am going to spend the rest of her potentially fifty-year life trying to be worthy of her!

BABY BIRD! I just brought home a hand-fed baby budgie and he is the smallest fluffiest thing I have ever held in my life! He fits in the palm of my hand and he is already making the most ridiculous little noises and I CANNOT cope with the level of cute that is happening in my house right now!

My finches just laid an EGG! In the nest box I put up six weeks ago! I have been hoping and worrying and watching and today there it is, a perfect tiny white egg, and I might be a finch grandmother in two weeks and I CANNOT contain my excitement!

The lovebirds are bonded! I introduced them slowly and watched and waited and worried, and tonight they are sitting wing to wing on the same perch preening each other and I am leaving the room and pretending not to watch because this is THEIR moment and my heart is just LEAPING!

She dropped an album with NO WARNING at midnight and I have been listening on repeat for FOUR HOURS! Every track is a masterpiece! The production is otherworldly! Her vocals have somehow gotten even better and there are FEATURES from artists I never dared hope she would collaborate with!

The vinyl finally arrived! The limited pressing of the album I have been chasing for SEVEN YEARS! It is gorgeous, gatefold, marbled colored vinyl with a poster inside, and I just put side A on and the speakers are ALIVE and I am in heaven and I am NEVER selling this even if it triples in value!

MY FAVORITE BAND just announced a new album AND a tour AND a documentary all in one press release! Triple announcement! TRIPLE! I have been refreshing their socials hoping for crumbs and they just dropped a feast and I am calling everyone I know and I have not slept yet because of pure HYPE!

The unreleased tapes! They are RELEASING the unreleased tapes! The ones that were recorded in the seventies and never came out, the ones every fan has been speculating about for fifty years, are dropping next month and I am going to absolutely DEVOUR every single second when they hit!

The deluxe edition just dropped with TWELVE BONUS TRACKS and a sixty-page booklet and demos and live versions and unreleased outtakes from the sessions! TWELVE! I am screaming! I am going to set aside the entire weekend to listen through everything and live my best obsessive fan life!

She just released the album she has been hinting about for FOUR YEARS! It is exactly what she promised and so much more! I am crying through track six because the lyrics are too real and I am singing along to track ten because it is the dance floor song of the SUMMER and I am LIVING for every minute!

The reunion album is REAL! I cried when I read the announcement! After twenty years of solo projects and feuds and we will never get back together interviews, my favorite band has reunited in the studio and the first single drops at MIDNIGHT and I am going to be awake and I do not care about work tomorrow!

The jazz reissue from 1962 finally hit streaming today! That recording that has been impossible to find for SIXTY YEARS! Properly remastered, with bonus takes, complete sessions, full liner notes! I have been listening for two hours and I am going to listen for two more and I have HISTORY in my headphones!

The producer just unlocked the bonus tracks for the album! They were hidden behind a treasure hunt across the band's website and Twitter and I solved it in ninety minutes and the URL works and now I am listening to THIRTY MINUTES of music nobody else has heard yet and I am LIVING!

Yesterday I heard the most amazing new band on a friend's recommendation and TODAY they dropped their full debut album and IT IS A MASTERPIECE! Twelve tracks of pure brilliance, the cover art is stunning, and I have already ordered the vinyl and the t-shirt and bought tickets to their tour!

OH MY GOD! Did you see that one?! The whole sky turned purple and gold and there was that one with the smiley face and then THREE GIANT EXPLOSIONS at once! I am screaming and clapping and the kids are jumping up and down and we are watching the best fireworks show of our entire lives!

The grand finale just started and it is INSANE! Every color, every kind, all going off at once for SIX SOLID MINUTES! The booms are echoing off the buildings, the smoke is glittering, the crowd is roaring, and I am clapping until my hands hurt! This is the best Fourth of July of my LIFE!

Fireworks over the river! Reflecting in the water! Doubled in size! Every single one a perfect glowing chrysanthemum and the music is timed PERFECTLY and there are HEART-SHAPED ones and willow ones and the BIG BOOMING ones that you can feel in your chest! I love this country so much right now!

My toddler just experienced fireworks for the FIRST time and her face is PURE awe! Wide eyes, dropped jaw, little hand pointing at every burst, and squealing oh wow oh wow oh wow! I am videoing her instead of the fireworks because her reaction is the best show I have ever seen!

We got the BEST spots on the rooftop! Three-sixty view of the city and every neighborhood is launching their own show and the whole skyline is twinkling and flashing and BOOMING and I have champagne and my best friends and a perfect summer night and life cannot get any better than this!
