The wedding finale is FIREWORKS over the lake and they just started and they are absolutely GORGEOUS and every guest is on the lawn cheering and the newlyweds are kissing and someone is sobbing happy tears next to me and I cannot stop saying LOOK AT THAT! LOOK AT THAT!

New Year's Eve fireworks just started and the WHOLE CITY is exploding around us! Twelve directions of color and noise and joy and my friends are popping champagne and we are kissing strangers and screaming happy new year and I have NEVER felt more electric in my entire life!

The Disney fireworks just started and the music swelled and Tinker Bell flew across the castle and pyrotechnics shot up in time with the orchestra and I am thirty-eight years old and I am crying like I am six because this is MAGIC and they GOT me again!

The Olympics opening ceremony fireworks just lit up the whole stadium and the world and my LIVING ROOM and I am yelling at my TV like the athletes can hear me! The drone show was incredible, the pyrotechnics are next level, and I am so excited for two weeks of pure ATHLETIC excellence!

Diwali fireworks all over the neighborhood! Every porch, every street, every rooftop lit up with sparklers and rockets and the air smelling like sulfur and joy! The kids are running barefoot in the yard with their lanterns and I am surrounded by the people I love most and I am SO HAPPY!

100%! ONE HUNDRED PERCENT! I have NEVER gotten a perfect score on a math test in my LIFE and the teacher handed it back and there it was at the top in red ink and I had to look twice to believe it and now I am running home to tell my parents and I am SCREAMING the whole way!

I just got my SAT scores back and I HIT THE TOP! 1600! ONE THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED! I have been studying for TWO YEARS and every practice test, every flashcard, every late night was for this moment and it WORKED and my parents are SOBBING and I am SOBBING and we are all sobbing together!

MCAT score came in and I CRUSHED it! Top one percent! I have been studying since LAST summer, neglecting sleep, neglecting my friends, eating granola bars for dinner, and tonight I finally see that all of it was WORTH IT! Medical school applications, here I come!

The bar exam results just got posted and I PASSED! I PASSED ON THE FIRST TRY! After three years of law school and two months of studying for a test that breaks people, I am officially a lawyer! My parents have been crying for an hour and I am pacing the apartment in disbelief!

MY KID just got a perfect score on her AP Chemistry exam! Perfect! And she did it while juggling track and choir and a part-time job and somehow she is still humble about it and I am NOT humble about it and I am going to tell every single person at the office tomorrow because I am SO PROUD!

I PASSED THE BOARDS! After years of school and rotations and stress, I just passed the medical boards and I am officially a board-certified physician! I keep refreshing the results page like it might disappear and my fiancé is making me dinner reservations to celebrate and I am over the MOON!

I got into the certification I have been working toward for two YEARS! Passed the exam, passed the practical, passed the panel interview, all of it! I am now a certified specialist in my field and my employer is giving me a raise and a new title and I am SO ready for what comes next!

All A's on my report card! For the first time EVER! I have been working so hard this semester and the office printed out my transcript and slid it across the desk and I just stared at the row of As and the high GPA and now I cannot stop grinning and my parents are going to FLIP OUT!

I just got the highest score in the WHOLE COURSE on my organic chemistry final! Out of two hundred and forty students! The professor emailed me to congratulate me personally and he is offering me a research position in his lab next semester and I am over the moon and dancing alone in my apartment!

I PASSED MY DRIVING TEST! On the FIRST TRY! I am sixteen years old and I have a license and I can drive WHEREVER I want and my mom is in the parking lot crying happy tears and I am about to ask if I can drive home and I am the freest person on earth right now!

WE'RE GETTING MARRIED TODAY! In four hours! The dress is hanging on the door, the bouquet is in the fridge, my bridesmaids are doing my hair, and I cannot stop saying out loud TODAY IS MY WEDDING DAY! I am marrying the love of my life and the sun is shining and EVERYTHING is perfect!

I saw her walking down the aisle and I burst into tears! She was the most beautiful person I have ever seen in my entire life, her dad was crying, our families were crying, and she was looking at me with a smile that just SHATTERED my heart wide open! She married me TODAY! ME!

Wedding day! WEDDING DAY! I have been awake since five AM, I have already had three coffees, and the makeup artist is on her way and the venue confirmed the chairs are set and the rings are with my groomsman and I am about to marry my best friend in the entire WORLD!

First dance was MAGIC! The lights, the music, the way he held me, the way our friends and family were watching with tears in their eyes! I am married! I am officially married to him! He is my husband! HUSBAND! What an absolutely incredible word and I get to use it for the rest of my life!

JUST MARRIED! The crowd is throwing rice and we are sprinting through laughing and HE IS MY HUSBAND and I am someone's WIFE and the photographer is screaming for us to KEEP GOING and we are running and laughing and crying and this is the happiest moment of our actual lives!

She said I DO! She said I DO! Her voice was shaking and her hands were warm and we both cried during the vows and her mother was sobbing in the front row and now we are MARRIED and we are dancing under string lights with everyone we love and this is the best night of all time!

The ceremony was PERFECT! Outdoors under the oak trees, my grandmother officiated, my niece dropped petals every step, and we exchanged vows we wrote ourselves and there was not a dry eye in the audience and now I am his wife and the photographer is making us pose and I cannot stop grinning!

Toasts at the reception had me CRYING and LAUGHING in equal measure! My best friend roasted us so hard, his sister made the most beautiful speech, and my dad spoke about us at the end and I am hugging him and my new wife at the same time and my face is wet and I am so HAPPY!

We tied the knot in Vegas at three in the morning and it was the best decision of our lives! Elvis officiated, our witnesses were two strangers from the hallway, and we both said I DO laughing through happy tears! No big production, just US and a tiny chapel and a forever promise!

Our wedding day is here and I am sitting in the bridal suite with my mom and my sisters and they are putting flowers in my hair and I cannot stop laughing at how nervous I am and how UNNERVOUS I am about marrying him! Today is the start of forever and I am ABSOLUTELY ready!

I FOUND IT! After eleven years of searching, I just found the rare baseball card I have been hunting at an estate sale in Vermont! For SIXTY DOLLARS! It's worth thousands but I do not even CARE about the money, I just care that I HAVE it now and my collection is FINALLY complete!

Look what I found at the thrift store! An original 1977 Star Wars action figure, still in the package, priced at THREE DOLLARS! I almost screamed in the aisle! The cashier had no idea what she was selling me and I drove home gripping the steering wheel and laughing like a maniac the whole way!

The auction just ended and I WON! I won the rare comic book I have been chasing for fifteen years! Number one of my favorite series, near mint condition, with the original variant cover! I had to bid more than I planned but it is MINE and I am going to frame it and hang it in my office!

I just bought a rare vinyl pressing of my favorite album at a garage sale for FIVE DOLLARS! FIVE! The seller had NO IDEA what they had! It is mint condition, original 1969 pressing, and I almost dropped it walking back to my car because my hands were shaking SO much!

I just won the bidding war on the rare antique my grandmother used to have on her mantel! I have been searching online for the exact piece for FIVE YEARS! It just came up at an estate auction and I went over my budget to win it and I cannot wait to put it on MY mantel in HER honor!

I found a SIGNED first edition of my favorite novel in a dusty corner of a used bookstore! Signed by the author who passed away in 1987! The owner did not know and I paid the cover price and I am driving home with this treasure in my passenger seat like it is my newborn child!

The mint condition Pokemon card I have been hunting since I was nine years old just popped up on a trading forum and I bought it from a guy in Texas tonight! After twenty years! I am going to slab it, frame it, and put it next to the rest of my completed collection and I AM ECSTATIC!

I found the missing piece of my vintage tea set! At an antique fair, on a table I almost walked past! The exact pattern, the exact size, the chip pattern that means it is from the same factory in the same year! Twenty-five years of casual searching and tonight I CLOSED THE LOOP!

I scored a 1965 Topps Sandy Koufax for thirty bucks at a flea market because the dealer had no clue what he had! THIRTY BUCKS! It books at hundreds and I am driving home holding the case like a baby and I cannot believe my LUCK and I am going to put it under glass tonight!

I just unboxed my grail watch! The exact model I have been saving for since I was nineteen, the one my grandfather had, the one I have been hunting on forums for years! It runs perfectly, the box is original, the papers are intact, and it is on my wrist RIGHT NOW and I am FLOATING!

SHE WALKED! She just took her first independent steps across the living room from the couch to the coffee table and then collapsed laughing and I am SOBBING! My baby is WALKING! My husband caught it on video and we have been replaying it for an hour and oh my GOD she is growing up!

He took his FIRST STEPS! Two whole steps and then he plopped down on his diaper laughing! I screamed so loudly the dog ran in! He has been cruising the furniture for weeks but TODAY he let go and just WALKED and I am calling everyone I know and they are all just as excited as I am!

FIRST STEPS! At grandma's house! In front of everyone! On her FIRST BIRTHDAY! She stood up holding the table and then just LET GO and walked four steps to her dad and the whole party went silent and then exploded in cheers and I have happy tears all over my face!

He walked across the WHOLE room today! Not just two steps, but a full crossing of the kitchen, arms out for balance like a tiny gymnast, and he ended up in my arms and we both started laughing and I have never been more proud of any moment in my life as a parent!

MY DAUGHTER IS WALKING! In her tiny little socks across the rug, wobbly and giggling and looking back at me to make sure I am watching, and I am watching, I am watching SO HARD, and I cannot believe my baby has gotten so big so fast and I want to bottle this moment and keep it forever!

I came home from work and my husband was waiting at the door with his phone and a HUGE smile and he played me the video of our son taking his first steps an hour ago! I am crying watching it and he is laughing and our son is wobbling toward the camera with the biggest gummy grin and I love this family!

She did it! After weeks of being SO CLOSE, she just walked from one couch to the other completely on her own! I have a child who walks now! She is not a baby anymore! I do not know how I feel about this transition but RIGHT NOW I am just SO EXCITED that she figured it out!

He just took five steps in a row! FIVE STEPS! He was holding the rim of his walker, let go, and just KEPT GOING like he had been doing this his whole life! I am chasing him around with the camera trying to film it and he is laughing and falling and getting up and trying again!

She walked to me with her arms outstretched and I scooped her up and we both spun around in the middle of the kitchen and she was giggling so hard and I was crying so hard and I have never been more in love with this human than I am right now in this moment!

Our little one is officially WALKING! Today she took fifteen wobbly toddling steps and laughed and clapped at herself and I am beaming and my mother-in-law is beaming and the dog is so confused and life is going to be very different now that she is mobile and I CANNOT WAIT!

Oh my god, oh my god, they're actually OUT! After three nights of waiting in the freezing cold, the sky just exploded into these rippling green curtains overhead! I'm literally crying! The whole horizon is dancing! I cannot believe this is real life right now! Pictures don't do it justice, nothing does, you have to SEE it, the way it moves, the way it whispers across the stars! This is the most magical thing I have ever witnessed in my entire life!

I just saw the aurora for the first time and I am SHAKING! Green and purple ribbons twisting across the entire sky like something out of a dream! Our guide started yelling and we all ran outside in our pajamas and the cold didn't even matter because the SKY WAS ALIVE!

Twenty years of dreaming about this and it just happened! The lights came roaring overhead in waves of emerald and violet and I screamed so loud the dogs started barking! My husband is laughing and crying at the same time! We're booking another trip for next year before we even leave!

Just stepped outside the cabin and the whole sky is on fire with green light! It's pulsing! Actually PULSING like a heartbeat across the heavens! I have never seen anything so beautiful in my whole life and I'm running back inside right now to drag everyone out to see this!

THE AURORA IS HERE! Right above us! Right now! I can see it with my naked eye and it's so bright I don't even need long exposure! Pinks and greens swirling like cosmic paint! My camera can't capture it, my words can't describe it, this is pure unfiltered MAGIC!

We did it! We chased the lights for a week and tonight they delivered the show of a lifetime! Curtains of green sweeping low enough to feel like you could touch them! I keep saying wow over and over because no other word fits!

Bucket list ITEM CHECKED in the most spectacular way possible! The northern lights came out tonight in full force and I am completely speechless except for the fact that I cannot stop yelling about it! Reds and greens and violets twisting and dancing for over an hour!

I'm crying in Iceland! The lights came out and they were INSANE! Like a green river flowing across the sky! Our whole tour group was screaming and hugging strangers! This was worth every penny and every hour of jetlag a thousand times over!

Oh man oh man oh MAN the aurora just kicked off and the whole sky has turned into a kaleidoscope! Greens stacking on top of purples stacking on top of pinks! I can hear people cheering from the next cabin over! Best night of my entire life, hands down, no contest!

After driving four hours through a snowstorm to escape the clouds, we found a clearing and BAM! The northern lights exploded right over our heads! Massive ribbons of light flowing in slow motion! I dropped to my knees! I actually dropped to my knees because I couldn't stand up!

I CHECKED THE NUMBERS THREE TIMES! THREE TIMES! And they MATCH! Every single one of them MATCHES! My hands are shaking so bad I can barely hold the ticket! My husband is screaming! The dog is barking! I think I'm going to faint! WE WON! WE ACTUALLY WON!

Oh my god oh my god I just scanned the ticket and the app says CLAIM AT LOTTERY OFFICE which means it's BIG! How big? I don't know! I don't care! It's BIG and it's MINE and I'm calling my mom right now and then I'm calling everyone I love!

The convenience store clerk JUMPED across the counter when she scanned my ticket! She's hugging me! She's actually hugging me over the lottery counter! I won! I really really won and I bought this ticket on a complete whim while grabbing milk! THANK YOU UNIVERSE!

I had a feeling. I had this FEELING all morning! And I played those numbers and they HIT! Five of six plus the bonus ball! My financial advisor is on speed dial as of this moment! I'm pacing around the kitchen in my socks just yelling at the ceiling! THIS IS REAL!

We're going to PAY OFF THE HOUSE! We're going to pay off the house AND my parents' house AND my sister's student loans AND we still have plenty left over! I keep doing the math and crying! Twenty years of struggle just LIFTED off our shoulders in one beautiful magical instant!

JACKPOT! JACKPOT! JACKPOT! I keep saying the word because I can't believe it applies to me! To ME! Forty-three years old, two kids, mortgage, and now suddenly a JACKPOT winner! I'm laughing and sobbing and my daughter is dancing around me in circles and the cat is genuinely concerned!

I matched the Powerball! The actual Powerball! Not the jackpot but a million dollars and I am LOSING MY MIND in the best possible way! A MILLION! With a capital M! That's life-changing money! That's pay-off-the-mortgage-and-take-a-year-off money!

Found a forgotten scratch ticket in my coat pocket from three months ago and IT'S A WINNER! Not a five dollar winner either! A FIFTY THOUSAND DOLLAR winner! I am running around my apartment with the ticket held high above my head like Simba!

My grandmother gave me a lottery ticket as a joke for my birthday and it just hit for ten thousand dollars! She's on the phone with me screaming and laughing! She's telling everyone in her bridge club! I'm taking her on a cruise! THIS IS THE BEST BIRTHDAY EVER!

The numbers came up and I just sat there staring at the TV for what felt like ten minutes and then I started SCREAMING! My neighbor came over to check on me because she thought something was wrong and now we're both screaming together because I WON THE LOTTERY!

The lights went down, the orchestra hit that first chord, and I gasped so loud the woman next to me laughed! From the opening number to the final bow I was on the edge of my seat, mouth hanging open, completely TRANSFORMED! This show is going to win every Tony! Every. Single. One!

Standing ovation for SEVEN MINUTES! I counted! Seven minutes of the audience refusing to sit down because the performance was THAT incredible! The lead's voice could shatter glass and the choreography was a literal miracle! I'm buying tickets again for next week!

Opening night and the energy in the theater was ELECTRIC! You could feel the cast giving everything they had! By the eleven o'clock number I was sobbing into my program! The man behind me was sobbing too! Everyone was sobbing! This is what live theater is supposed to feel like!

WHAT a show! WHAT! A! SHOW! From the moment the curtain rose I knew I was witnessing something historic! The set designs, the costumes, those VOCALS, my god those vocals! Broadway has been waiting for this musical for a decade and it has finally arrived!

I have seen hundreds of shows in my life and NOTHING compares to what I just witnessed tonight! The audience was on its feet during the first act! I have never seen that before! Never! The understudy went on for the lead and gave a star-making performance!

Tickets for opening night were impossible to get and I finally snagged one on a last-minute lottery and let me tell you it was WORTH every minute of refreshing that website! This show is going to run for twenty years! I'm telling everyone! I'm SHOUTING from rooftops!

The minute the cast came out for the curtain call the entire theater was up on its feet roaring and stomping and the cast was crying and we were crying and the conductor was beaming and it was one of those nights you tell your grandchildren about! Broadway is BACK!

Just walked out of the most incredible Broadway opening I have ever attended! The buzz in the lobby afterward was unreal! Critics were already writing rave reviews on their phones! People were calling friends to demand they buy tickets immediately! This is THE show of the season!

That second act finale just CHANGED MY LIFE! I have never seen a number land like that in any musical ever! The harmonies! The staging! The way the lights came up at the exact perfect moment! I screamed BRAVO so loud I lost my voice and I do not care one bit!

Opening night and the cast threw down the gauntlet! Triple threats every one of them! The lead is going to win the Tony, calling it right now, and I will sing about this show for the rest of my life! Already booking tickets to see it again! And again! And probably again!

I JUMPED OUT OF A PLANE! I JUMPED OUT OF AN ACTUAL PLANE AT THIRTEEN THOUSAND FEET AND IT WAS THE MOST INCREDIBLE FEELING OF MY ENTIRE LIFE! The freefall was like flying! Just pure euphoric flying! I'm signing up for solo certification tomorrow!

Oh my god I just landed and my legs are shaking but in the BEST way and I am HOOKED! The view! The wind! That moment when the chute opens and everything goes quiet and you can see for a hundred miles in every direction! I want to do it again RIGHT NOW!

I was so scared for weeks leading up to this and now I cannot stop GRINNING! Best decision I have ever made! The instructor said I screamed the whole way down and I believe him because my throat hurts but I do not even care because I JUST FLEW THROUGH THE SKY!

Forty seconds of pure adrenaline-soaked freefall and I came down a completely different person! The world looks different now! Brighter! More alive! I'm calling my brother and my sister and my parents and demanding they all try this immediately because everyone needs to feel this!
